SELECT
    promotion_category,
    total_discount_amount,
    total_discount_amount / sum(total_discount_amount) OVER () AS discount_share,
    rank() OVER (ORDER BY total_discount_amount DESC) AS promotion_category_rank
FROM
(
    SELECT
        ifNull(dp.PromotionCategory, 'Unknown') AS promotion_category,
        sum(discount_amount) AS total_discount_amount
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            PromotionKey,
            DiscountAmount AS discount_amount
        FROM retail.FactSales
        WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            PromotionKey,
            DiscountAmount AS discount_amount
        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
        WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
    ) AS s
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimPromotion AS dp
        ON s.PromotionKey = dp.PromotionKey
    GROUP BY promotion_category
)
ORDER BY total_discount_amount DESC, promotion_category ASC
